verdict.rationale: Docs cover fiat-out via ACH/Fedwire/Swift/SEPA, auto-liquidation of onchain deposits, USDC-to-USD treasury conversion, and Onramp/Offramp bidirectional fiat-crypto movement via API/CLI/SDK, which together support a finance lead's rebalancing needs. However, evidence is all first-party docs with no dashboard UI walkthrough, no explicit 'internal transfer between balances' ledger concept, and no independent verification of end-to-end reliability. Missing for 10: dashboard-based transfer documentation, explicit internal balance-to-balance transfer API (vs onchain/fiat rails only), independent/hands-on corroboration of the full flow.
